summary: End-to-end testing for Russian medical device monitoring platform. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (root, meta, incidents create with severity classification, validation 422/400, list newest-first w/o _id, stats, PDF download). Frontend: Home/Document/Report/Admin all render and integrate correctly. Form validation works on empty submit; valid submission creates incident and shows success screen with report ID; admin KPIs/charts/filters/table work; PDF link points to /api/document/pdf. Zero console errors.

issues: Role tab labels appear duplicated in DOM text (e.g. 'Медицинская организацияМедицинская организация'). Likely a responsive long/short label pair without sr-only/hidden class hiding one. Cosmetic only — clicks still work.
Multiple nested elements share the 'flow-step-' data-testid prefix (11 matches for 5 steps). Consider scoping testids (e.g. flow-step-btn-{n} vs flow-step-detail-{n}) to make E2E selectors cleaner.

action_items: Optional: Hide duplicated long/short role tab labels with hidden/sr-only utility classes or render only one variant.
Optional: Disambiguate flow-step-* data-testids between step buttons and their detail panels.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file and clean (~360 LOC) — no need to split yet.
MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in list/stats — good.
PDF endpoint uses DejaVu font with Helvetica fallback — supports Cyrillic correctly.
Severity classification logic is centralized in _classify_severity — good.
All env vars come from .env (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS) — no hardcoded URLs.
Pydantic validation enforces email + min/max description length — backend returns 422 correctly.
All major UI elements have data-testid attributes — meets testability guideline.
test_credentials: N/A — admin route is open by user's choice (no auth).
seed_data_creation: Created 4 incidents via tests (1 critical UI + 1 critical/1 serious/1 standard backend) prefixed with TEST_ in email field. Visible in admin panel; safe to leave or purge from 'incidents' collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers all endpoints. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
